lines.reference: Cream, fluid, heavy whipping — USDA FDC 170859 (SA fresh cream ~36 % fat): 340 kcal / 100 g

Caramelised condensed milk: Nestlé Carnation Caramel label 1281 kJ (306 kcal), SA Caramel Treat 284 kcal (FatSecret ZA); used 300 kcal, 6.5 g protein, 7.5 g fat, 53 g carbohydrate / 100 g (used 300 kcal / 100 g)
Peppermint-crisp milk chocolate, SA (FatSecret ZA): 2107 kJ, 4.7 g protein, 23.9 g fat, 66 g carbohydrate / 100 g (used 504 kcal / 100 g)
Coconut tea biscuits, SA (Bakers Tennis Classic Coconut, FatSecret ZA): 1937 kJ, 21.9 g fat / 100 g; protein 5.5 g, carbohydrate 61 g by difference (used 463 kcal / 100 g)

notes: Assumptions that change the number: SA caramelised condensed milk at 300 kcal / 100 g (Nestlé caramel labels run 284–306); coconut tea biscuits at 463 kcal / 100 g; cream ~36 % fat. Sanity check: The Cinnamon Jar's original tart is 361 kcal a slice for 8 slices, made with 1 tin of caramel, 250 ml cream, 1 packet of biscuits and 1 bar. This recipe is double that, cut into 12 rather than 16, so the expected figure is 361 × 16 ÷ 12 ≈ 480. Ours, at 540, is ~12 % higher, from the extra chocolate (150 g against ~100 g). Other home recipes list 180–360 kcal for smaller slices; a café slice (Mugg & Bean) is 828.
